references.text: Moses and Aaron fall on their faces before the congregation of Israel, the same reaction as here when they encounter rebellion and crisis.
Later in the same chapter, Moses and Aaron again fall on their faces when the Lord's wrath threatens the congregation.
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces when the plague begins to strike the people, the same humble attitude toward God.
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces at the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord appears to them.
Abram falls on his face when God speaks to him, the same reverent response to God's presence.
Joshua falls on his face to the ground in awe before the commander of the Lord's army.
Ezekiel falls on his face when he sees the glory of the Lord, the same humble response.
